decisions.reason: The navigation and observation camera builds directly on the firm's established optical and space-qualified electronics know-how, and its dedicated web page signals strong commitment, so it is easy to assimilate and improve through in-house R&D.
The modular navigation camera extends the same camera knowledge base, so the firm can interpret early feedback and adapt modules efficiently, which justifies keeping it on the market.

The situational awareness sensor suite draws on the firm's sensor and optics expertise and serves a growing market; its systems integration is somewhat further from the core, but cooperation with research institutions supports continued development.

The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned on the website and lies further from the camera core, which makes learning from it harder, but space product cycles are long and related electro-optical knowledge supports keeping it for now.
